title: Negative for hunting in c62's Flow-Lenia ecology: the free predators live on prey matter recycled as a dilute film; product from prey bodies alone sustains only ~25% of them
summary: On fresh seed 21 (claim world, 160^2, noise start), from t=1000 the predators' digestion product was made only inside prey bodies (A_sum > 0.1) or only from the dilute film of recycled prey matter (A_sum <= 0.1), with digestion itself unchanged. Predator bodies over t=1500-2000: 6.6 with bodies-only product, 25.0 with film-only product, 25.2 unchanged; prey stay depressed in the film-only arm (12.9 vs 13.0; twin 17.4). Before the switch 31% of all digestion happens more than 3 px from any prey body, and the film alone keeps the predators' gain q/(q+0.01) above 0.8 in every predator pixel. The 'free predators hopping between prey' are grazers of a recycled nutrient field; the predator-prey interaction runs through recycling, and the hops are not how they feed.

finding.operator: digestion-product yield restricted to prey bodies vs to the dilute recycled prey film (eating unchanged)
finding.control: matched arms from the same t=1000 state of seed 21 and the unchanged run
finding.result: predator bodies t=1500-2000: bodies-only 6.6, film-only 25.0, unchanged 25.2; 31% of digestion > 3 px from prey bodies; one seed
